name: open-record-negative-test-5c62171999/open-record-nil-able-fn-ptr-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: "Anonymous function expression", "Field access expression", "Method call", and "Mapping constructor"

Invocations / Named and default arguments: "Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature."
reason: The four marked errors assert rejection of direct invocation of a nilable function-valued record field, including after assigning an anonymous function to that field. Record type definitions, field access and assignment, anonymous functions, positional invocations, and local declarations are within the supported constructs; no listed restriction excludes this negative type-checking behavior. The atomic-function restriction concerns named/default arguments, whereas these invocations supply positional arguments.
test_design_notes: All four @error sites test nilable function field invocation; two use explicit function|() syntax and two use function? syntax.
Assignments to the record field in the first and third functions do not change the asserted expectation of rejection.
